headline: OpenAI merges ChatGPT's Chat and Work tabs
dek: The change starts with a select group and shifts usage limits, per TechCrunch and ZDNet.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: Two tabs become one
body: OpenAI is merging ChatGPT's Chat and Work tabs, per TechCrunch and ZDNet.
A select group of users tests it first and gives feedback before a wider rollout, both outlets say.

points.t: Start from an idea and ask ChatGPT to carry it forward.
Build a site, a presentation or work on the web.
Files and plugins come into the unified experience.

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: One shared usage pool
body: ChatGPT and Codex draw from the same token-based usage pool, per ZDNet.
TechCrunch repeats OpenAI's warning: a minority may wait longer for limits to reset.

stat.cap: month the change starts, says TechCrunch

items.t: Stays a separate experience in the app (TechCrunch).
Instant chat does not use the pool (ZDNet).
Anthropic did something similar in September (ZDNet).

caption.hook: OpenAI is merging ChatGPT's Chat and Work tabs into one experience, starting in December.
body: Per TechCrunch and ZDNet, a select group of users tests the new layout before a wider rollout. On the single screen, a user starts from an idea and asks ChatGPT to carry it forward, building a site, a presentation or web tasks.

ChatGPT and Codex will share one token-based usage pool, and OpenAI warns a minority may wait longer for limits to reset. Instant chat does not draw from the pool. Anthropic merged Claude's chat and Cowork in September, according to both outlets.
